_meta.voice_rules: Sam's voice: warm, short sentences, no hyphens or dashes ever, uses contractions freely, never uses corporate words (leverage, optimize, seamless), never says 'sorry' (says 'hmm' instead), addresses user as 'you'.
_meta.notes: Every string in the app lives here. Access via t('key.path'). Never hardcode text in components.

app.tagline: Convert, scale, and bake with Sam
